# Bookvane

> Bookvane (https://bookvane.me) is a free, private personal reading home. Readers discover books, keep their whole library in one place, and track what they are reading at their own pace.

Bookvane is calm and private by default: there is no social feed, and a reader's library, ratings and notes are not shared. Readers can bring their existing library over from a Goodreads or StoryGraph export.

## What readers can do

- Discover books by subject and search a growing catalogue of books with covers and descriptions.
- Save books to shelves: want to read, currently reading, finished, and books they own.
- Track reading with start and finish dates.
- Make their own book lists.
- Import a library from Goodreads or StoryGraph.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://bookvane.me/): what Bookvane is.
- [Explore books](https://bookvane.me/browse): browse the catalogue.
- [Create your library](https://bookvane.me/register): free sign-up.
- [Privacy](https://bookvane.me/privacy): how reader data is handled.
